buyBody: Script in baby blue, tonal on tonal. The quietest hat we make. The lettering is the same color as the panel and you only find it up close.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, close crop. Tonal stitching needs raking side light or it disappears entirely. This is the hardest hat in the range to photograph and the brief should say so. There is no on-body hat photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
